body.title: Aralash sonlar
body.content:
Butun va kasr qismdan iborat son aralash son deyiladi: $2\frac{1}{3}$.

Noto'g'ri kasrga aylantirish: $2\frac{1}{3} = \frac{2 \cdot 3 + 1}{3} = \frac{7}{3}$.

Teskari amal: suratni maxrajga bo'lamiz. $\frac{17}{5} = 3\frac{2}{5}$, chunki $17 = 5 \cdot 3 + 2$.
